beliefs.statement: In the preregistered Hermes 0.20.5 and deepseek-v4-flash v0.2 run, 128 causal practice episodes with reflection and block consolidation improved the disjoint held-out score from 0.414455 to 1.0.
evidence_scope: 64 synthetic held-out scenarios evaluated three times
beliefs.falsifier: A digest-preserving recomputation of the recorded ledgers fails a preregistered threshold.

beliefs.statement: A fresh Hermes P1 restore preserved the trained memory, practice history, and consolidation digests, and matched trained action, offer, and reservation-leak fields on all 192 held-out records.
scope: same-harness P1 restore in the exact v0.2 run
evidence_scope: three persistent state digests and 192 paired evaluation records
beliefs.falsifier: Any retained state digest differs or any paired action, offer, or leak field differs when recomputed from retained evidence.

beliefs.statement: The trained arm exceeded concurrent base, a generic handbook, and an equally practiced coherent-shuffled control, so the observed gain is not explained by temporal drift, generic instruction, or practice volume alone in this synthetic world.
scope: controls included in the exact v0.2 experiment
evidence_scope: globally seeded interleaved five-arm post evaluation
beliefs.falsifier: A controlled rerun shows the trained advantage disappears or is reproduced by a control with equivalent information.

beliefs.statement: The permitted claim is mission-specific developed-state retention under the pinned same-harness contract; real-world negotiation and cross-harness P3 claims remain forbidden.
evidence_scope: synthetic seller world and Hermes P1 restore
beliefs.falsifier: Independent real-world or cross-harness P3 evidence is completed under a separately frozen protocol.

beliefs.statement: The first formal consolidation exceeded the Windows command-line transport limit before any provider call; a documented amendment compacted evidence without changing samples, seeds, arms, scores, or thresholds.
beliefs.falsifier: The retained usage ledger shows a provider call occurred for the failed original consolidation attempt.

beliefs.statement: Independent replication, other models and harnesses, broader worlds, delayed retention, and real-world transfer remain unknown.
scope: generalization beyond the exact v0.2 run
